build_HiFiCEncoder: build a HiFiC encoder module that encodes images into 220 latent features using conv2d blocks
build_HiFiCGenerator: build a HiFiC generator module that decodes 220 latent features back into images using residual blocks
run_HiFiCEncoder_forward: run the HiFiCEncoder forward pass to encode an input tensor into a compressed latent representation
run_HiFiCGenerator_forward: run the HiFiCGenerator forward pass to decode a latent tensor back into a reconstructed image
review_ResidualBlock: review the _ResidualBlock class that applies two conv layers with channel normalization and skip connection
